constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_usage_events_pkey ON public.ai_usage_events USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_usage_events_request_id_key ON public.ai_usage_events USING btree (request_id)
CREATE INDEX ai_usage_events_user_flow_created_idx ON public.ai_usage_events USING btree (user_id, flow, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ai_usage_events_ip_created_idx ON public.ai_usage_events USING btree (ip_hash, created_at)
